## Quaternary / MEF position structure — returned by the tools

**Call 1 — `capabilities`**: MEF registry `1.0.0-q2` (revision 1); wiki refraction contract `ql-mef/wiki-refraction/v1`, deterministic, provider available.

**Call 2 — `mef lenses`** returned the twelve MEF lens positions. The quaternary structure: **three squares, each holding four lens positions** (two day/night pairs):

- **Square A — Articulation (4 positions):** L0 Quaternal (day) · L5 Para Vāk (day) · L0′ Archetypal-Numerical (night) · L5′ Divine Logos (night)
- **Square B — Encounter (4 positions):** L1 Causal (day) · L4 Phenomenological (day) · L1′ Phenomenal (night) · L4′ Scientific (night)
- **Square C — Becoming (4 positions):** L2 Logical (day) · L3 Processual (day) · L2′ Alchemical-Elemental (night) · L3′ Chronological (night)

**Call 3 — `wiki-refraction`** of the reading scene (target = movement 16 at rev `330f0cf0…`, tangent relation movement 15 → 16, selected relation Dimensional Reframing → 16) returned **status complete at all twelve positions above** — one `MEF-derived` reading per position (provider `ql-mef:provider:registry-disclosure`, confidence 1000), each carrying the same derived subgraph: 3 vertices (movement 16 primary, movement 15 tangent, Dimensional Reframing selected) and 2 relations (tangent, selected).
